scenes.title: Integer powers and roots 1
rows: The base is the whole bracketed number −4.
Multiply (−4) by (−4): the two negative factors give +16.
actions: Identify the operands and required operation in (−4)².
The base is the whole bracketed number −4.
Multiply (−4) by (−4): the two negative factors give +16.
Check 4² = 16 and distinguish (−4)² from −4².
Conclude that (−4)² = 16; check the preceding operations against the question.
scenes.misconception: Evaluate brackets, powers and roots before left-to-right multiplication/division and then addition/subtraction.

scenes.title: Integer powers and roots 2
rows: The exponent applies to 4 only because there are no brackets.
Calculate 4² = 16 before applying the leading negative sign.
actions: Identify the operands and required operation in −4².
The exponent applies to 4 only because there are no brackets.
Calculate 4² = 16 before applying the leading negative sign.
Check −4² = −16, whereas (−4)² = 16.
Conclude that −4² = -16; check the preceding operations against the question.
scenes.misconception: Evaluate brackets, powers and roots before left-to-right multiplication/division and then addition/subtraction.

scenes.title: Integer powers and roots 6
rows: Add the results: 25 + 7 = 32; check both original parts.
actions: Identify the operands and required operation in (−5)² + √49.
Evaluate the bracketed square: (−5)² = 25.
Evaluate the principal root: √49 = 7.
Add the results: 25 + 7 = 32; check both original parts.
Conclude that (−5)² + √49 = 32; check the preceding operations against the question.
scenes.memo: (−5)² + √49 = 32. Add the results: 25 + 7 = 32; check both original parts.

The result is −7; check −27 + 20 = −7.
Conclude that (−3)³ + 20 = -7; check the preceding operations against the question.

rows: Evaluate √100 = 10 and retain the principal positive root.

Evaluate √100 = 10 and retain the principal positive root.
Cube −2 to get −8.
Subtracting −8 adds 8: 10 − (−8) = 18.
Conclude that √100 − (−2)³ = 18; check the preceding operations against the question.

scenes.title: Integer powers and roots 10
actions: Identify the operands and required operation in (−6)² ÷ (−3).

Evaluate √36 = 6, the non-negative root.
Add −5 + 6 = 1 and check both roots.

scenes.title: Integer powers and roots 12
actions: Identify the operands and required operation in (−2)⁴ − ∛(−8).
Four negative factors give (−2)⁴ = 16.
The cube root of −8 is −2.
Subtract −2 from 16 to obtain 18.
Conclude that (−2)⁴ − ∛(−8) = 18; check the preceding operations against the question.
scenes.misconception: Evaluate brackets, powers and roots before left-to-right multiplication/division and then addition/subtraction.

scenes.title: Integer powers and roots 13
rows: Inside the second bracket, ∛(−27) = −3; add 5 to get 2.

Inside the second bracket, ∛(−27) = −3; add 5 to get 2.
Multiply 9 × 2 = 18 and substitute into the original brackets.
Conclude that (−3)²[∛(−27) + 5] = 18; check the preceding operations against the question.

scenes.title: Integer powers and roots 14
actions: Identify the operands and required operation in [√64 − ∛(−64)] × (−2).

Inside the bracket, 8 − (−4) = 12.
Multiply 12 by −2 to get −24.
Conclude that [√64 − ∛(−64)] × (−2) = -24; check the preceding operations against the question.
scenes.misconception: Evaluate brackets, powers and roots before left-to-right multiplication/division and then addition/subtraction.
